head.architecture: shared profile encoder with two outputs per side: softplus distance and softplus conditional scale plus 1e-4
head.pooling: mean and max over 257 scalar samples, then mean over 3 radii
head.feature_normalization: channel-wise mean/std over all samples and radii of the 18 sealed train objects only; std=sqrt(population_variance+1e-6); statistics frozen before optimization and hashed in receipt
head.scalar_normalization: canonical outward distance transformed as log1p(distance), then train-only population mean/std with epsilon 1e-6
head.loss: per-object mean of joint_score + 0.05*mean(log(scale)); joint_score=max_side(abs(predicted_distance-target_distance)/scale); one row per object
head.swap_audit: maximum absolute difference between swapped predictions/scales and side-reversed originals must be <=1e-6

training.initialization: torch.manual_seed(2202), CUDA manual_seed_all(2202), Xavier-uniform weights and zero biases in module traversal order
training.batch: full batch of exactly 18 unique train objects in lexicographic object_id order; no shuffle
training.checkpoint: write exactly one final step-4000 checkpoint; no intermediate selection, early stopping, or best checkpoint
training.rerun: after optimizer initialization or any target read, any exception is terminal and no retry is allowed; before either event, infrastructure retry is allowed once only with byte-identical request and an immutable failure receipt

fixed_comparators.coordinate_only: all nine geometry channels set to zero; retain scalar coordinates; replaces duplicate zero_geometry and order_only names
fixed_comparators.scalar_only_mlp: shared per-sample MLP Linear(1,64)-SiLU-Linear(64,64)-SiLU, mean/max sample pooling, radius mean, same two-output readout
fixed_comparators.pooled_summary_mlp: concatenate per-side per-channel mean and max plus scalar mean and max across radii/samples; MLP Linear(20,64)-SiLU-Linear(64,2)
fixed_comparators.fixed_permutation: reverse feature sample indices 256..0 within every radius while leaving scalar coordinates at original indices
fixed_comparators.unshared_head: two independently initialized side encoders/readouts with otherwise identical architecture and training configuration
fixed_comparators.evaluation: run every comparator exactly once on the identical frozen train/calibration/confirmatory object split; never use comparator results for selection or reruns

conformal.quantile: q is sorted calibration score at 1-indexed rank ceil((n_cal+1)*0.9); fail if rank>n_cal
conformal.constant_radius_comparator: r is the same finite-sample quantile of max_side absolute residual; intervals use distance plus/minus r
conformal.width_reporting: descriptive only; report mean joint interval width for both methods only when both use the same nine calibration objects and same rank, and report confirmatory joint coverage beside width; no superiority gate or matched-coverage interpolation
